    (Fs.NameSet.except [])).cur !! b = V.now.entry j b

theorem walAreaOf_inj {d d' : GoString} (hd : ∃ n, d = memberDataDir n) (hd' : ∃ n, d' =
    memberDataDir n) (h : walAreaOf d = walAreaOf d') : d = d'

    [W : WalFs.WalGS GF] (r : GoString) : ⊢ WalFs.walPast (WalFs.walBoot0St r) -∗ WalFs.dirDurable r

    R) (h' : (r', j) ∈ R) : r = r'

    memberDataDir n) : walAreaOf d ≠ d'

    Fs.Roots) (V : Fs.Hist) (hV : V.snd = []) (hR : Fs.RootsOk R) (hrb : ReceiptBoundLe GF (2 ^ 62))
    (Ds : List GoString) (Js : List Fs.Ino) (M : GMap GoString Unit) : Ds.Nodup → (∀ (d : GoString),
    d ∈ Ds → ∃ n, d = memberDataDir n) → (∀ (d : GoString), d ∈ Ds → Fs.DirFits (srvWalDirOf d)) →
    (∀ (d : GoString), d ∈ Ds → ∃ j, (walAreaOf d, j) ∈ R ∧ j ∈ Js ∧ ∀ (b : GoString),
    WalFs.AreaSlot b → V.now.entry j b = none) → (∀ (d : GoString), d ∈ Ds → ∃ j, (d, j) ∈ R ∧ j ∈
    Js ∧ ∀ (b : GoString), V.now.entry j b = none) → (∀ (d : GoString), d ∈ Ds → M !! walAreaOf d =
    some ()) → (∀ (d : GoString), d ∈ Ds → M !! d = some ()) → ⊢ Fs.osInv -∗ Fs.osSharedInv R -∗
    Fs.osAboveInv -∗ ([∗list] j ∈ Js, Fs.osNames j (Fs.NameSet.except []) (DFrac.own 1) (Fs.namesOf
    V j (Fs.NameSet.except []))) -∗ ([∗map] r ↦ _u ∈ M, Fs.osCallPerm r 1) ={⊤}=∗ [∗list] d ∈ Ds,
    memberAreasFresh d
